text: This solution, United Nations Development Programme – Insurance and Risk Finance Facility, Nepal (UNDP IRFF Nepal) addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in Nepal between Government of Nepal, United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), Insurance Development Forum (IDF), German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ), Milliman, and IIN. The program was implemented in 2024 and focuses on collaboration, raising awareness, and leveraging tech.
